name: Garfield's Lasagna
description: A hearty layered lasagna with ground beef, cottage cheese, and mozzarella, perfect for a crowd.
recipeIngredient: 10 oz can mushroom pieces and stems

recipeInstructions.text: Thoroughly brown the ground beef in a frying pan. Add onions and garlic; cook until tender.
Add spaghetti sauce, diced tomatoes, mushrooms, oregano, and salt. Simmer for 20 minutes.
Cook lasagna noodles as directed on the package. Rinse noodles in cold water using a colander.
Blend cottage cheese with approximately 2 cups of the mozzarella cheese.
Spread a thin layer of sauce in a greased 9x13 inch pan. Alternately layer 1/3 each of the noodles, sauce, and cheese mixture. Repeat 2 times until you have 3 layers.
Sprinkle remaining mozzarella cheese on top. Bake at 350°F for 45 minutes.
Let stand for 10 minutes before serving.

keywords: lasagna, ground beef, cottage cheese, mozzarella, layered pasta

recipeInstructions.text: Combine cottage cheese and Parmesan cheese in a bowl.
Spread 1½ cups of spaghetti sauce in the bottom of a 13x9x2 inch pan.
Arrange a layer of uncooked lasagna noodles on top of the sauce, overlapping slightly.
Sprinkle half of the mozzarella cheese and half of the cottage cheese mixture over the noodles.
Repeat with another layer of sauce, noodles, and the remaining cheeses.
Cover the top with sauce and cover tightly with heavy foil.
Set on a jelly roll pan and bake.

_similar.name: Baked Spaghetti and Meatballs
_similar.description: A hearty baked pasta dish featuring meatballs, spaghetti, and a rich tomato-based sauce topped with melted mozzarella cheese.

recipeInstructions.text: Preheat oven to 350°F and start boiling water for cooking spaghetti.
In a large bowl, mix ground beef, chopped onion, egg, Worcestershire sauce, and black pepper. Form into meatballs.
Fry the meatballs in a skillet until completely cooked, turning gently with tongs. Drain off excess fat.
Add spaghetti sauce, diced tomatoes, mushrooms, green pepper, and oregano to the skillet. Simmer for approximately 15 minutes.
Cook spaghetti until 'al dente', then rinse and drain.
Combine cooked spaghetti with sour cream.
Pour the spaghetti mixture into a greased 6-cup casserole dish. Sprinkle with half of the shredded mozzarella cheese.
Cover with the sauce and meatball mixture. Bake, uncovered, at 350°F for approximately 20 minutes.
Top with remaining cheese and bake for an additional 5 to 10 minutes, or until the cheese is melted.

_similar.name: Noodles with Hamburg
_similar.description: A hearty casserole featuring ground hamburger, macaroni, and a blend of vegetables and cheese.

recipeInstructions.text: In a frying pan, brown the hamburger with celery and onions (if using). Drain excess fat.
Add garlic powder, oregano, salt, tomato soup, corn, and canned tomatoes to the browned hamburger mixture. Stir to combine.
Simmer the mixture slowly for 20 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Cook macaroni according to package instructions until al dente. Drain and set aside.
Combine the cooked macaroni with the hamburger and sauce mixture. Stir well.
If using cheese, heat it until melted and mix into the noodle and hamburger mixture.
Serve hot.

_similar.keywords: hamburger casserole, noodle dish, comfort food
